evidence: reconcile-bridge.yml:273-276: '# rebar-specific: the reconciler leaves inbound events UNCOMMITTED and makes / # its own binding-store commit WITHOUT pushing. So we (a) commit any dirty / # state, then (b) push whenever the local tickets branch is ahead of origin / # — a clean worktree does NOT imply nothing to push.'

reconcile-bridge.yml:285-288: '# The strict, synchronous store core owns commit, CAS recovery, and clean-ahead / # delivery; this workflow remains a thin adapter ...' then 'REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always python -m rebar._store.push commit-and-push --tracker . ... --strict ...'

This diff's stated intent (subject/body) is to 'describe the strict synchronous core adapter accurately' after the CAS-loop cutover, yet the sibling step comment still narrates the removed YAML commit-then-push-if-ahead behavior — an internal contradiction the change was meant to eliminate.
